candidate_generation_and_validation.energy_check: Recompute S(C_prime), g(C_prime), and full exact G(C_prime) from all N cells for accepted candidates.
candidate_generation_and_validation.minimum_support_search: When computing rho_m(r), examine support diameter in nondecreasing integer rho and stop only after a strict descent at the first fully exhausted rho layer; if earlier rho layers are not exhaustive, report only a bound.
candidate_generation_and_validation.set_semantics: U and V are unordered sets; no duplicate sites; |U|=|V|.
candidate_generation_and_validation.support_check: Compute exact maximum pairwise triangular-lattice graph distance over U union V.
candidate_generation_and_validation.symmetry_use: D6 stabilizer canonicalization may quotient duplicate move classes for counting/search acceleration but may not change admissibility, support diameter, or energy.
candidate_generation_and_validation.topology_check: Construct C_prime exactly, then verify connected and hole-free before accepting.

delta_q_zero_policy.checker_rule: Evaluate DeltaS and recomputed full exact G. The centroid correction term is retained exactly.
delta_q_zero_policy.post_identity_expected_consequence: Once the centered-shell identity is proved, DeltaQsum=0 gives DeltaG=-Q(DeltaS), so strict descent occurs exactly when DeltaS is nonzero; equality DeltaS=0 is a plateau and is inadmissible.
delta_q_zero_policy.pruning_rule: Never discard a candidate merely because DeltaQsum=0.

exact_move_statistics.delta_Q_sum: DeltaQsum=sum_{v in V} Q(v)-sum_{u in U} Q(u)
exact_move_statistics.delta_S: DeltaS=sum_{v in V} v-sum_{u in U} u
exact_move_statistics.full_G_checker_authority: Until Stage A verification, candidate acceptance is determined by recomputed full exact G; after verification the identity remains cross-checked against full G.

initial_state: Always H_r for the shell-escape quantities; H_r is reconstructed exactly from its axial inequality.
locality_model_dependency: R056_LOCALITY_MODEL.json; hash frozen in the same Stage 0 checkpoint

allowed_ingredients: bounds on Q(DeltaS) in terms of fixed (m,rho)
proof_first_route.finite_search_role: counterexample discovery, exact small cases, theorem stress testing, and validation only; finite-radius regression is never a theorem.
proof_first_route.suggested_pruning_goal_not_assumption: Show that a fixed-width boundary patch has DeltaQsum>=1 for all non-equality legal replacements when r is large, then compare N_r*DeltaQsum against the bounded centroid correction; audit DeltaQsum=0 separately.

m_rho.definition: m_rho(r)=min |U| over all admissible strictly G-decreasing replacements from H_r with diam_L(U union V)<=rho

rho_m.definition: rho_m(r)=min diam_L(U union V) over all admissible strictly G-decreasing replacements from H_r with 1<=|U|=|V|<=m
rho_m.infinity_evidence_rule: May be recorded only after a mathematical proof excludes all moves or after an explicitly complete finite search of the entire admissible move space; a bounded failed search yields only a lower bound.

theorem_target.generalization_guard: A result for one fixed m is not silently generalized to all fixed m.
theorem_target.preferred_equivalent_goal: For every fixed m, rho_m(r)->infinity as r->infinity.
theorem_target.preferred_strengthening: For each fixed m, prove rho_m(r)>=c_m*r-O_m(1) with explicit c_m>0.
theorem_target.quantifier_guard: m and rho must be fixed before the all-large-r statement; a bound depending on r is not fixed locality.
theorem_target.statement: For every fixed finite pair (m,rho), there exists r0(m,rho) such that every integer r>=r0 has no admissible D(m,rho) strict descent from H_r.
